method.terminal_format_scope: Only nonempty outputs already marked invalid by frozen parser; inspect final nonempty line; require a standalone decimal0..383 with optional Answer prefix/period, or balanced Markdown bold around integer. This is a formatting classification, not a new prediction or score.
method.terminal_format_case_handling: First regex case-insensitive; both whole-line fullmatch; additionally require integer<384. No gold label is consulted.
method.raw_sample: Within each of six budget(4096/16384) x output_state(parsed/empty/nonempty_invalid) strata, lexicographically sort case identity SHA256 filenames and inspect first8;48total. Nonrandom audit sample; not a prevalence estimator.
method.reference_check_separate: Check all keyed references/case order/existing score targets only for alignment and frozen hash identity; do not apply a new extraction rule or compute counterfactual accuracy.
method.modification_scope: Only this audit JSON is created; all evaluation inputs, raw outputs, parsers, scores, protocols and processes remain untouched.

limitations: 851 terminal-label cases are format observations, not851 correct answers. No counterfactual gold-scored parser recovery is reported.

findings.statement: CLOSED native source substring matching can credit ambiguous text containing both yes and no. V03 correction changes the denominator, not this substring predicate. OPEN token recall is a lexical score and can reward verbosity; reported headline scores are not strict semantic answer accuracy.

All500 final outputs contain15–263 words (median70), but strict scoring matches the whole normalized final. Zero exact matches does not demonstrate500wrong clinical predictions. Historical official executable is unrecovered.

Native scoring extracts only the final character then applies source choice similarity. The2% native and49.75% adapted full-text scores are different output extraction protocols; neither should be silently substituted for the other.

ROUGE measures lexical overlap, not biological factuality. Parsed counts include any string record, including empty strings; they are not complete usable-answer counts. Many outputs reached the cap. Exact BioT5+ paper metric equivalence remains unresolved.

All197 replay raw responses reconcile with archived text/finish and request hashes. Every response contains one explicit ANSWER tag agreeing with its saved parser prediction. Per-case saved flags reproduce77correct and188non-abstentions; labels/source mapping were not newly read.

Prior425-case FigQA/TableQA audit reconstructs publisher prompts, permutations, actual image bytes and request mappings with no discrepancy. Prior P01/P02/P10/P11 source audit has matching ordered sequence/label canonical hashes. B04 native-wrapper re-encoding changes pixels under a diagnostic runtime; historical effect on scores is unknown.

Published values are contextual: zero-shot Qwen versus specialist/task-trained systems and differing prompt, decoder, image, split and repeat conditions. Mixed4K/16K results are explicitly qualified. No controlled model ranking or contamination-free claim is supported.
